basics.name: Qing Dai
basics.label: PhD Candidate, UCLA Radiology & Bioengineering
basics.summary: PhD candidate developing real-time imaging, AI, and computational tools to make minimally invasive interventions safer and more precise. Work spans algorithm development, machine learning, computational modeling, and integrated hardware/software systems, validated end-to-end from phantom through ex vivo and in vivo studies. Two patent-pending technologies.

highlights: Advisor: Dr. Holden Wu, Magnetic Resonance Research Lab (MRRL), Department of Radiological Sciences, David Geffen School of Medicine
Affiliated with the Jonsson Comprehensive Cancer Center

patents.title: Active electromagnetic interference (EMI) suppression for MR thermometry during MRI-guided procedures
Keypoint detection network for needle localization in MRI-guided interventions
